In how many ways can 5 boys and 3 girls be seated in a row so that no two girls are together?
questions.explanation: Seat the boys in 5! = 120 ways; the 6 gaps take the girls in 6P3 = 120 ways. 14400.

In how many ways can the letters of the word ORANGE be arranged so that the three vowels occupy the odd positions (1st, 3rd and 5th)?
questions.explanation: The vowels O, A, E take the 3 odd places in 3! = 6 ways and the 3 consonants take the even places in 3! = 6 ways: 36.

questions.question: The rank of the word CAT among the arrangements of its letters in dictionary order is

questions.question: How many 4-digit numbers greater than 5000 can be formed from 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 without repetition?
questions.explanation: The first digit is 5, 6 or 7 (3 ways); the other three digits arrange from the remaining 4 in 4P3 = 24 ways: 72.
